preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_permission WHERE code = 'BYPASS_TWOFACTOR'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = 1 AND p.code = 'BYPASS_TWOFACTOR'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT 1, p.id FROM m_permission p WHERE p.code = 'BYPASS_TWOFACTOR' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = 1 AND rp.permission_id = p.id );
